title: Preserve these files in 30 minutes
scenario: An email labeled “Legal Hold – Immediate” says the company has 30 minutes to preserve evidence and asks you to upload project files to an external secure-transfer portal. The sender name matches outside counsel.

answers.A: Upload because legal-hold deadlines can be strict and delaying could create liability.
answers.B: Verify the legal hold with internal legal counsel or the known outside-counsel contact before uploading confidential files.
answers.C: Preserve the files internally first while the transfer destination is verified.

explanation: Legal urgency can make unusual data movement seem necessary. Preserve first, transfer only after verifying destination and authority.
proTip: A deadline can justify preservation, not an unverified upload.
